distractors.reason: We don't say 'make fun' to mean enjoy yourself. 'Make fun of' means to mock someone, which is a different meaning.
We don't say 'do fun'. 'Do' is used with tasks such as do homework or do the dishes.
We don't say 'take fun'. 'Take' is used with actions such as take a break or take a photo.

example_sentence: We ___ a lot of fun at the party.
l1_interference: Os falantes de português costumam associar o verbo 'fazer' a todas as situações, por isso podem dizer 'make fun' ou 'do fun'. Em inglês, para expressar diversão, usamos 'have' com 'fun'.
explanation: In English, 'have' is used with many nouns that describe experiences and feelings, such as have fun, have a good time and have a break. Learn the whole phrase as one unit.

related_collocations.example: We had a good time at the beach.
I always have lunch at twelve.

memory_tip: HAVE + experience (have fun, have a break, have lunch) | MAKE + creation (make a cake, make a plan)
